svg.title: Competency dictionary · Collaboration
svg.desc: Illustrative reconstruction · No client data shown. Collaboration, a generic transversal competency. Definition: Coordinates interdependent work by exchanging useful context, agreeing shared responsibilities and resolving hand-off problems with others. Four behavioural indicators: Shares changes that affect another role before the next hand-off. Confirms who will complete each joint task and when. Checks assumptions with colleagues before resolving a coordination issue. Records agreed next steps so others can act on the same information. No employee scores or proficiency levels.
